beta.notes:
**New in beta60**
- One clear status in the TV player: while a channel is starting, reconnecting or has failed, a single line in the info band says so. A failed channel shows the reason, Retry (already selected), Versions when the channel has other versions, and Back to Live TV.
- The channel list over the picture is one solid column that is easier to read. Press Right on a channel for its schedule; Back closes one layer at a time.
- The shortcuts at the bottom of the player always fit: with many recent channels the extra shortcuts make room instead of being cut off at the edge.
- Movies and series: the info band now says what holding OK opens (Sound, Subtitles, Picture).
- Calmer and lighter: the status no longer flashes for a short stall, nothing in the info band moves when the picture arrives, and a channel's schedule is loaded only when you ask for it.
